cases.original_xml: <head><date when="1790-06-15" calendar="#gregorian"><hi rendition="#u">Bäder in <hi rendition="#aq"><placeName ref="https://edition-humboldt.de/H0005512 https://www.geonames.org/11609031">Derbyshire</placeName></hi></hi></date></head>
cases.editorial_task: Inspect a dated diary heading while preserving nested typography, the place label, and the source-encoded calendar date.
required_observations: One head contains date, whose when is 1790-06-15 and calendar is #gregorian.
The date contains a hi with rendition #u. Its ordered mixed content is text Bäder in followed by a nested hi with rendition #aq.
The inner hi contains placeName with text Derbyshire and ref exactly https://edition-humboldt.de/H0005512 https://www.geonames.org/11609031.
Nested hi extents and their containment remain inspectable even where equal extents occur; identical spans do not make distinct source elements identical.
The two external place reference tokens remain pointers; this experiment does not resolve their entities or certify their truth.
explicit_non_claims: The when value does not establish the date Humboldt wrote the entry.
Calendar and rendition pointers are retained, not resolved into an acquired project registry.

cases.editorial_task: Offer the heading's main reading independently from an unknown-hand archival note, while retaining the note and the modern editorial explanation with their relationships.
cases.editorial_note_text: Handschriftliche Notiz, Bleistift von unbekannter Hand: Altsignatur der Sammlung Radowitz/Archivsignatur.
required_observations: The main heading's reading order remains prefix Reise. 1790. followed by England.; 6255 and the editorial explanation are not inserted into this task's primary reading.
A source lb remains locatable between prefix and unknown-hand note.
The outer note has hand #unknown. Preserve that encoded uncertainty; do not attribute 6255 to Humboldt.
Within that note, ref xml:id bab01c0c-9760-4703-b01c-0c9760d7037b contains 6255 and points via corresp to #f05a05fb-11de-42d0-9a05-fb11def2d021.
The editorial note has xml:id f05a05fb-11de-42d0-9a05-fb11def2d021, type editorial, resp #CT #DE, and reciprocal corresp #bab01c0c-9760-4703-b01c-0c9760d7037b.
The outer unknown-hand note and inner modern editorial note remain separate objects with distinct responsibility information.

If all note prose inhabits the same character sequence, primary heading membership must exclude those note characters and is discontinuous; a contiguous envelope alone does not preserve this task observation. A separately stored note is an alternative policy with an explicit insertion attachment.
explicit_non_claims: The discontinuous primary reading is a project-defined editorial task observation, not proof that the original TEI tree is defective.
No claim that the official edition UI implements this projection was tested.
